concept: Empowerment through Health Education and Intervention
rationale: The testimonials consistently highlight the role of community health workers in educating their communities about various health issues, providing first aid, and referring individuals to appropriate medical services. They also emphasize the importance of preventive measures and early intervention in managing health conditions. The community health workers' efforts have led to increased awareness and behavior change in their communities, demonstrating the empowering effect of health education and intervention.
examples: Bunnyce Atieno on Abortion: I talked to a group of young girls who agreed to open up about their abortion experience and none of them enjoyed even a bit of it. I agreed with them that there would be no more abortion.

Daniel Ayieko on Asthma: But to me as a CHW I thought that it would be best if the child was to be taken to the hospital for medical examination so that the mother could know what was wrong with the child.

Daniel Ayieko on COVID-19: Having trained as a Community Health Worker, I have been actively sensitizing and creating awareness to my community members on the preventive measures against the COVID-19 pandemic.
Imelda Anyango on Malaria: As a CHW, what I can do to help people with malaria is to advise them to go to the hospital and get tested and also to be treated well whenever the symptoms occur.
Bunnyce Atieno on Menstrual Hygiene/Teenage Pregnancy: From this I, as a CHW, decided to partner with other ??? and individuals to fundraise for pads to give these girls.
